title: Positive-degree exterior tensor quotient kernels are locally spanned by quotient relations
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], S=(K→B→C) a short exact sequence of O_X-module sheaves with maps f,g, A a module sheaf, and r,s natural numbers with s≠0. Use exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Suppose q:(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s B)→(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s C) takes every pure wedge tensor a⊗c to a⊗g(c). For an open U, a section t of its domain with q(t)=0, and x∈U, there is an open neighborhood V⊆U of x such that t|V lies in the O_X(V)-linear span of tensors wedge(a)⊗wedge(c) where c_j=f(d) for some j∈Fin s and section d of K on V.

proof.text: Fix a point x. Exactness on stalks identifies C_x with B_x/im(f_x). Present exterior powers by their alternating multilinear generators and relations. Quotienting B_x by im(f_x) adds precisely the relations that wedges with an argument in im(f_x) vanish: multilinearity expands changes of representatives into these relations, so the resulting quotient has the universal property of the exterior power of C_x. Tensoring with the exterior power of A_x is right exact. Pure wedges span this first factor, so the tensor kernel is spanned by the displayed pure wedge tensors. Exterior powers and tensor products commute with stalks, since their presentations use finite sums and finite tuples and commute with filtered colimits and scalar extension. The formula for q identifies its stalk map with this quotient map. Express the germ of t as a finite linear combination of these generators. Represent the finitely many coefficients, wedge entries, and preimages under f_x on one common neighborhood V of x contained in U. Shrink V to make every equation c_j=f(d) hold for sections, and shrink once more to make the linear combination equal to the restriction of t. The resulting equality proves membership in the displayed span. The assumption s ≠ 0 excludes the degree-zero isomorphism case, handled separately by the caller. For r=0 the empty wedge generates the first factor. At a zero stalk ring all modules are zero; on an empty open there are no points to check.
